Regarding the operational processes at LuxFunds, the reliance on paper-based expense reporting and approval is a significant bottleneck. This manual system causes a backlog of unprocessed claims, delays reimbursements, and leads to employee dissatisfaction. Additionally, the manual entry process increases the risk of human error. To improve efficiency, LuxFunds should transition to a digital expense management system to automate approvals, reduce processing time, minimize errors, and enhance employee satisfaction.
